options.description: List of command-line options to pass to fuse2fs via -o; each item is a full option string (e.g., 'ro', 'errors=panic', 'debug') as accepted by fuse2fs(1). Must match documented fuse2fs and FUSE options. No nested objects; each item is a scalar option string. The file content is rendered as-is, one option per line for clarity, but fuse2fs expects comma-separated -o values in practice — the template flattens to a single invocation at runtime via the invoking service wrapper (not part of this schema/template). This file is a convenience for service configuration management only; the underlying fuse2fs process receives -o options from the service command (e.g., /usr/bin/fuse2fs -o ro -o debug /dev/sda1 /mnt/ext). The service wrapper (not defined here) would construct the final command from this list. This template only expresses the configuration data structure and its canonical rendering, not execution semantics. For use, a service unit must invoke fuse2fs with -o <comma-joined-options> or equivalent. Do NOT include the device or mountpoint here — those are service-specific parameters outside this config scope. Only include valid -o options documented in fuse2fs(1) or mount.fuse(8).
